stock.description: KNT Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, focusing on the worldwide production and trade of apparel. Its operational reach extends across significant markets such as the United States, Europe, Hong Kong, and Australia. The firm supplies a varied range of products to apparel businesses, including bridal gowns, bridesmaid dresses, and other special occasion attire, as well as general fashion apparel, textiles, and accessories. Additionally, KNT Holdings offers a comprehensive suite of supplementary services, encompassing market trend analysis, product conception and refinement, raw material acquisition, manufacturing supervision, quality control, and stock administration. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
